data.one_liner: Flutter renderer for Sanity.io Portable Text format with block, span, and style support.
data.what_it_does: Renders Sanity.io Portable Text format content inside Flutter applications. Supports standard and custom blocks, spans, annotations, and styles with helpful inline error messages for unregistered elements.
use_when: You need to render Sanity CMS portable text content in a Flutter application.
You want custom block and custom mark support for rich text rendering.
avoid_when: You are not using Sanity.io as your backend CMS.
You only need to render basic Markdown or HTML strings.
strengths: Complete support for standard Portable Text styles and marks.
Extensible architecture for custom blocks, custom marks, and custom list builders.
Developer-friendly error handling for unregistered elements.
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Sanity.io Portable Text format.
FSL-1.1-MIT license requires attention regarding commercial terms.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and register any custom blocks or mark definitions if needed.
